title: AI POD orchestrator run status
description: Lifecycle state for a single orchestrator run, atomically written to status.json in the run directory. heartbeat_utc is refreshed while running so readers can identify stale runs without a progress estimate. Shared by every subsystem; the shape does not vary.

run_id.description: Run directory basename, of the form <UTC timestamp with microseconds>-<host>-<action>.

state.description: A SIGKILL or power loss can leave `running` behind. Readers should compare heartbeat_utc with the current time; an expired heartbeat is stale, not evidence of percentage progress.

pid.description: Process id of the orchestrator, recorded so a reader on the same host can distinguish a genuinely running run from an abandoned one.

heartbeat_utc.description: Last lifecycle heartbeat. Refreshed every 10 seconds while state is running; terminal writes set it to the final update time.

exit_code.description: Process exit code. 0 success, 1 completed but the result is a failure, 2 operational error, 3 downgrade blocked, 128+signum when terminated by a signal.

error.description: Sanitized exception or error summary when available; null when the run has no additional error detail.
